title: The source watcher reports a deletion under a worktree's own .tmp/termal-test-state-* runner directory as an active-turn source change
outcome: Runner-owned test-state paths under a worktree's own .tmp/ (for example .tmp/termal-test-state-<uuid>/…) are never captured or attributed as source changes of an active turn, while real source files in nested .tmp/ worktrees stay observed, as workspace_watch.rs deliberately does today. The filter is narrow: it classifies runner-owned test-state paths and does not blanket-ignore .tmp.
acceptance: The source watcher reports a deletion under a worktree's own .tmp/termal-test-state-* runner directory as an active-turn source change is done
